svg.title: Governance layers
svg.desc: Four layers guard the architecture. dart analyze, arch_check.dart and run_all.sh run in order in the CI Check job and locally; a failure in any of them fails the build. ADRs and architecture docs are the review-time layer that decides what the gates encode.

g.text: Hover a gate for what it enforces; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Layers 1 to 3 fail the CI Check job, each seeing what the one before cannot. Layer 4 decides what they enforce.

g.text: CI JOB · CHECK · THE SAME GATES RUN LOCALLY

svg.text: unresolved imports, stale re-exports, type mismatches: what the analyzer sees
ADR-034 dependency direction · ADR-056 package topology · ADR-054 one authority per concern

g.text: dart analyze · the Dart analyzer; CI runs the format check before it and the workspace tests after it
An info-level diagnostic fails the job, so lints cannot accumulate as informational noise.
arch_check.dart · one script, one line per check and a summary; exits non-zero on any failure
Counts lines and matches patterns over source text with dart:io alone, so it runs without package resolution.
run_all.sh · the broad gate: six scripts, two schema checks, config-reference drift, version lockstep, then run-fitness.sh
The Dart suite runs last because it holds the gates that read an allowlist; run a gate file whole, never name-filtered.
ADRs and docs · why a boundary exists and when it may change
A check changes in the same change as this document and any affected ADR; a threshold is never loosened silently.
core barrel · dartclaw_core.dart must not re-export the whole kernel barrel
Targeted show re-exports stay allowed, so core cannot launder the kernel surface to its consumers.
provider options · raw ['inherit_user_settings'] lookups appear only in dartclaw_kernel
The allowed files are claude_provider_options.dart and config_parser.dart; a raw lookup elsewhere is the violation.
fails at 110% of the recorded target
lib/ LOC target · one target per member with a lib/, _libLocCeilings; a member without a target fails
lib/src/generated/ is not counted, and shrinkage never fails, so only growth needs a recorded decision.
package count · _workspacePackageCeiling; apps/dartclaw_cli and dev/fitness sit in the root workspace outside the count
The ceiling is a number in code, so a fifteenth package is a deliberate, reviewed edit.
dependency_direction · an import points only at a strictly lower tier in dev/package_tiers.txt; same-tier edges fail
It also reconciles pubspec dependencies with real imports and fails a workspace member that has no tier.
no_second_implementation · a public production type name is declared in one workspace member only (ADR-054)
The allowlist is a ratchet that may shrink and not grow; it holds TurnManager and TurnRunner, ports with adapters.
size limits · max_file_loc_test, max_test_file_loc_test and constructor_param_count_test
An allowlisted file may not reach 110% of its recorded baseline; an entry for a file that shrank or vanished fails.
no_framework_coupling · zero andthen literals in dartclaw_workflow/lib/src outside built-in definition YAML (ADR-041)
The engine validates declared schema only; framework semantics live in definitions and skills.
no_prose_parsing · asks whether a named retired construct is back, not whether code is a prose parser (ADR-054)
No allowlist: each pattern was measured at zero first, so a match is a finding against the change that reintroduced it.
no_external_origins · served templates, CSS and the CSP load no subresource from an external origin
The same script family holds check_css_comment_state, check_no_workflow_private_config and the task_executor reference check.
The committed JSON schemas must equal what the generators produce from the typed code.
config reference · check_config_reference_drift.sh compares the guide's config reference with the renderer output
test_render_config_reference.sh checks the renderer itself first.
check_versions.sh · every published package, apps/dartclaw_cli and each packaging artifact that pins a version match version.dart
A mismatch fails the job, so a release cannot ship half-bumped.
